title: F6 Showcase
purpose: One small app demonstrating every frontend coverage feature (layoutSlot, operator console, dashboard, third nesting level, client-side CEL), one section per feature, each backed by a real browser check.
walkthrough: Generate and boot the f6-showcase sample with the sample app generator script in NPDevSamples/scripts.
Open the Ticket board panel: the KPI strip above and the timeline below the table are app-owned slot components.
expectedOutcomes: Ticket board shows a KPI strip (Total 4, OPEN 2, IN_PROGRESS 1, DONE 1) above the generated table and a priority-ordered timeline below it.
